openFindings.title: cli-opencode reference retains the superseded V4 Flash operational default
openFindings.evidence: Current operational invocation, default table, preflight, recovery, and model-selection guidance name opencode-go/deepseek-v4-flash, while the provider roster names V4.1 as the mode default.
openFindings.recommendation: Replace every operational default and recovery reference with opencode-go/deepseek-v4.1-flash; retain the old id only when explicitly historical or optional, then rescan non-changelog surfaces.
openFindings.scopeProof: The packet requires the opencode-go id on every retained surface, and five current cli-reference instruction points disagree with the current provider roster.
openFindings.normalizedDescription: cli-reference still advertises the superseded V4 Flash route as default

openFindings.title: Pi default configuration and custom-provider guidance disagree with the active provider catalog
openFindings.evidence: Settings select llmgateway with z-ai/glm-5.3-flash, but that id is declared under cline-pass while the llmgateway block declares bare glm-5.3-flash; the docs state cline-pass is the default and llmgateway is not used by fan-out.
openFindings.recommendation: Choose one valid default provider/model pair, synchronize settings, model catalog, provider docs, roster, and fan-out guidance, and add a same-block default-resolution check.
openFindings.scopeProof: The checked-in Pi settings, model catalog, custom-provider guide, cli-pi roster, and fan-out provider map are all named packet surfaces and show incompatible default contracts.
openFindings.normalizedDescription: Pi docs contradict settings and fan-out about the active default provider

openFindings.title: Continuity percentages do not distinguish implementation completion from release readiness
openFindings.evidence: Decision record continuity says 100%, implementation summary and handover say 85%, while closure remains not closeable and manual verification is unchecked.
openFindings.recommendation: Align continuity percentages or label implementation completion separately from release readiness, keeping the open-gate state authoritative.
openFindings.scopeProof: All cited files are packet continuity or closure surfaces used by resume readers and release-readiness review.
openFindings.normalizedDescription: continuity files report percentages that conflict with open release gates

openFindings.title: Unit-test description still names the old model
openFindings.evidence: The test title names deepseek-v4-flash while the assertion directly expects deepseek-v4.1-flash on the next line.
openFindings.recommendation: Rename the test to state deepseek-v4.1-flash and keep the assertion as the source-of-truth check.
openFindings.scopeProof: The executor-config unit test is an explicit implementation and verification surface for the packet's model-default change.
openFindings.normalizedDescription: unit-test description names old model while assertion expects V4.1
